title: spec: action param helpText is a plain string, so it cannot be localized (invite_user role help shows only in English)
body:
Filing gate ②: fallout measured by the cloud#3383 pin round (pin 99a6a781, branch claude/project-thread-yynugk @ b983a3b, landing with cloud#3385). Filed by `repo:cloud` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

框架给「邀请成员」的角色参数加了一段说明文字（objectstack#28224），但 spec 里参数的 helpText 只是一个普通字符串，不能按语言翻译。所以中文用户在 cloud 的欢迎页上看不到这段说明，在别处看到的也只有英文。这张卡让参数说明可以本地化。

## Facts

- objectstack#28224 added an English `helpText` to the `invite_user` role param.
- The spec types action param `helpText` as `string`, so there is no i18n key or per-locale form. cloud's welcome copy therefore leaves it out.

## Work

1. Make action param `helpText` localizable the way other user-facing action strings are (an i18n key, or the existing translatable-string shape), without breaking a plain string.
2. Translate the `invite_user` role help in the locale packs.
3. Contract review (spec), tests, and a changeset with the Clause-② line.

## Done when

A zh session sees the role help in Chinese.
